name: destruction-boss-phases
description: Validate depth-block damage stages, bounded physics debris, world reconstruction, boss phases, and danger-zone telegraph.

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("PunchWallAutomation") c:Invoke("Reset") c:Invoke("ResetWorld") c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=2,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local w=workspace.PunchWallRPG["Depth Blocks"].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 local maxHP=w:GetAttribute("MaxHP") c:Invoke("HitWall","Brick Wall") local damage=maxHP-w:GetAttribute("HP") return H:JSONEncode({stage=w:GetAttribute("DamageStage"),singleHitDamage=damage>=1.9 and damage<=2.1,hpBelowMax=w:GetAttribute("HP")<maxHP,broken=w:GetAttribute("Broken"),changedColor=w.Color~=w:GetAttribute("OriginalColor"),canCollide=w.CanCollide,transparency=w.Transparency})

local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game:GetService("ServerStorage").PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=120,CritChance=0}) c:Invoke("HitWall","Brick Wall") local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local w=root["Depth Blocks"].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 local debris=root["Depth Physics Debris"] local targetChunks=0 local frontSafe=true for _,chunk in ipairs(debris:GetChildren()) do if string.find(chunk.Name,w.Name,1,true)==1 then targetChunks+=1 if (chunk:GetAttribute("InitialForwardSpeed") or 0)<=0 or (chunk:GetAttribute("SpawnFrontOffset") or 0)<=0 then frontSafe=false end end end return H:JSONEncode({broken=w:GetAttribute("Broken"),hp=w:GetAttribute("HP"),stage=w:GetAttribute("DamageStage"),targetChunks=targetChunks,debrisCount=#debris:GetChildren(),withinBudget=#debris:GetChildren()<=120,frontSafe=frontSafe,canCollide=w.CanCollide,canQuery=w.CanQuery,transparency=w.Transparency})

steps.label: depth-block collapse feedback and debris budget

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local w=root["Depth Blocks"].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 return H:JSONEncode({broken=w:GetAttribute("Broken"),hp=w:GetAttribute("HP"),debrisCount=#root["Depth Physics Debris"]:GetChildren()})

steps.label: physics debris cleans up without hidden auto-respawn

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game:GetService("ServerStorage").PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("ResetWorld") local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local w=root["Depth Blocks"].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 return H:JSONEncode({broken=w:GetAttribute("Broken"),hp=w:GetAttribute("HP"),stage=w:GetAttribute("DamageStage"),transparency=w.Transparency,anchored=w.Anchored,canCollide=w.CanCollide,canQuery=w.CanQuery,collisionGroup=w.CollisionGroup,resetBlocks=root:GetAttribute("LastWorldResetDepthBlocks")})

steps.label: world reset reconstructs depth structure cleanly

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local c=game:GetService("ServerStorage").PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke("SetStats",{WallLevel=99,Depth=75,Power=200000000,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local result=c:Invoke("HitBoss") local b=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Walls["Titan Server Wall"] local zone=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Polish["Wall Tier Frames"]:FindFirstChild("Titan Danger Zone") local deadline=os.clock()+11 repeat if zone and zone.Transparency<1 then break end task.wait(0.25) until os.clock()>=deadline return H:JSONEncode({resultOk=result.ok,phase=b:GetAttribute("BossPhase"),participants=b:GetAttribute("ParticipantCount"),weakPoints=b:GetAttribute("WeakPointCount"),dangerZone=zone~=nil,telegraphVisible=zone and zone.Transparency<1 or false,roar=b:FindFirstChild("Boss Roar")~=nil})

steps.label: boss phase and timed danger-zone telegraph
